Dear [Mr Chandler](/person/1864)
I think your friends MS is Vallombrosa but there is no address on it, and another about a Family Adventure in Normandy equally unaddressed has come to me, so that I am not sure which is which[^1] Both are good but I like Vallombrosa best and gladly accept it. I am just starting for a few days at Salisbury

yours truly

C M Yonge


[^1]: Neither article has been identified in [MP](/periodical/52).
